sweetMoments.headline: Sweet Moments at El's
sweetMoments.subtitle: Follow our daily baking journey, live frosting reels, and client setups in Lagos.

products.name: Classic Chocolate Birthday Cake
products.description: Decadent chocolate sponge layered with creamy cocoa frosting and finished with chocolate curls & truffles.
products.full_description: Our signature chocolate masterpiece. Baked with premium Belgian cocoa, layered with velvety chocolate frosting, and delicately decorated with handmade chocolate curls and fresh seasonal berries. Ideal for adult and children celebrations.

products.name: Pink Buttercream Cake
products.description: A playful pink buttercream cake decorated with Oreo halves, chocolate chunks, and cookie crumb edging, topped with a black and gold Happy Birthday topper.
products.full_description: Designed specifically to celebrate milestone anniversaries and deep romantic bonds. Features vintage European shell piping, hand-crafted sugar roses, lustrous gold text, and rich, moist cake inside.

products.name: White Ribbed Buttercream Cake
products.description:
A chic white ribbed buttercream cake adorned with pearl beads, gold splatter and soft white roses.
Topped with a gold acrylic "Happy Birthday BOSS" topper for a classy, boss-worthy celebration.
products.full_description: Bring personal memories to life on a delicious cake. Send us any high-resolution portrait, family photograph, or company logo, and our food-safe sugar sheet printer renders it vividly on delicious buttercream.

products.name: White Buttercream Retirement Cake
products.description:
A chic white buttercream cake with a purple floral fault line band trimmed in gold, accented with gold leaf flakes.
Topped with fresh pink and purple roses and a "Congratulations on your Retirement" butterfly topper  elegant and celebratory for a retirement send-off.
products.full_description: An impressive, towering statement cake crafted for major milestone birthdays (30th, 40th, 50th, 60th+). Features elevated double-barrel height, gold-leaf leafing, gourmet French macarons, and exquisite sugar artistry.

products.name: Romantic 3-Tier Peony Wedding Cake
products.description: A timeless all-white 3-tier fondant cake, elegantly minimal with smooth, flawless finish. Adorned with lush blush pink and white peonies nestled between tiers, creating a soft, romantic cascade.
products.full_description: Handcrafted for intimate to mid-sized Nigerian weddings and traditional marriage receptions. Clad in smooth ivory fondant or velvet buttercream with cascading sugar flora and hand-painted metallic accents.

products.name: Three-Tier Wedding Cake
products.description: Grand three-tier luxury architectural cake featuring bespoke structural support, gold leaf, and floral cascade.
products.full_description: The pinnacle of luxury patisserie. Three majestic tiers structured with internal dowelling for flawless stability. Flavour combinations can be customized per tier (e.g. Tier 1: Red Velvet, Tier 2: Chocolate Fudge, Tier 3: Vanilla Bean). Includes white-glove setup and delivery across Lagos.

products.name: White Textured Buttercream Cake
products.description: A white textured buttercream cake with gold splatter, cascading pearl beads and white ranunculus roses, topped with a gold glitter "Happy Birthday Wendy" topper  elegant and luxurious for a special birthday.
products.full_description: Engineered for executive events, staff birthdays, client appreciation, product launches, and end-of-year office festivities in Lagos. Feeds 30 to 60 colleagues with precision slicing lines and custom corporate colors.

products.name: Yellow Grey Marble Birthday Cake
products.description: A striking yellow buttercream cake with grey marbled patches outlined in gold, topped with ruffled grey-yellow rosettes, chocolate chunks and caramel crumble. Finished with a silver glitter "Happy Birthday" topper and a handwritten "Happy Birthday to a dear one!" note.
products.full_description: A Nigerian celebration staple crafted with artisanal flair. Deep scarlet moist crumb infused with buttermilk and cocoa, paired harmoniously with tangy-sweet Madagascar vanilla cream cheese frosting and subtle 24k gold leaf flakes.

products.name: Blue Ribbed Buttercream Cake
products.description: A soft baby blue ribbed buttercream cake with white piped swirl border, sprinkled with pearl beads and icy blue sugar crystals for a frosty shimmer. Topped with a gold "September Celebrants" toppe
products.full_description: Timeless elegance in every bite. Pure Bourbon vanilla infused cake layers covered in silky, melt-in-your-mouth whipped buttercream. Beautifully dressed in subtle pink and cream swirls, perfect for children and adult birthdays alike.

products.name: Teal Ribbed Buttercream Cake
products.description: A vibrant teal ribbed buttercream cake with elegant gold splatter and white pearl details, topped with a gold palm fan, white ranunculus blooms, gold orbs and a "Happy Birthday November Celebrants" gold topper.
products.full_description: Refreshing, summery, and luxuriously light. Made with layers of fluffy sponge infused with wild strawberry essence, house-made strawberry reduction, and whipped dairy cream frosting decorated with glazed ripe berries.

products.name: 9th Birthday Roblox Cake
products.description: A fun teal to light yellow ombre ribbed buttercream cake with colorful sprinkles, featuring a large Roblox avatar face print, a number 9 topper, Roblox logo topper and 3D Roblox character toppers
products.full_description: The ultimate celebratory showstopper. Moist chocolate cake cloaked in velvet frosting, featuring a glossy handcrafted chocolate ganache drip cascading over the sides, crowned with Ferrero Rocher chocolates and crisp wafer pearls.

products.name: Purple Gold Splatter Floral Cake
products.description: A dreamy lilac to purple ombre buttercream cake with luxurious gold splatter, crowned with lush magenta peonies, purple blooms, yellow carnations and delicate white filler flowers
products.full_description: Trending vintage Lambeth aesthetic crafted with romantic flair. Carved into an adorable heart shape, featuring ruffled buttercream borders, delicate drop swags, and bespoke custom lettering for your significant other or loved one.

products.name: Superman 10th Birthday Cake
products.description: A bold sky-blue buttercream cake with city skyline wrap, featuring Superman standing tall. Topped with multiple Superman flying toppers, iconic S-shield, "BAM! BOOM! POW!" comic bursts, gold pearl accents, and a custom "DAVID ROCKS @10" topper with "HAPPY BIRTHDAY".
products.full_description: A caramel lover’s absolute dream. Alternating layers of fluffy vanilla sponge and gooey salted caramel drizzle, coated in smooth whipped caramel buttercream, finished with crisp toffee bits, artisan macarons, and delicate gold dust.

products.name: 5th Birthday Fancy Nancy Cake
products.description: An adorable light pink buttercream cake for Chimamanda — themed with Fancy Nancy character toppers, a large pink striped number 5 with yellow crown, "Fancy Nancy" and "Ooh La La" signs, plus butterflies, sunglasses, lipstick, Frenchy the poodle and fancy accessories. Sprinkled with purple and pink confetti.
products.full_description: Understated elegance meets vibrant freshness. Made with authentic Madagascar Bourbon vanilla pods, frosted in ultra-light Swiss meringue buttercream, and piled high with fresh imported strawberries, blueberries, and delicate floral garnishes.

products.name: 7th Birthday Elena of Avalor Princess Cake
products.description: A vibrant pink buttercream cake bursting with magic — decorated with Elena of Avalor character toppers, golden number 7 with crown, "happy birthday" topper with rainbow, plus Zuzo the blue fox and Skylar the jaquin. Finished with pink, gold and pearl sprinkles and a front Elena cutout.
products.full_description: Created for life’s most cherished celebrations—from 21st, 30th, 50th birthdays to wedding anniversaries. Features textured ivory buttercream, a cascade of handmade sugar flora, and personalized message banner in metallic gold.

products.name: Festive Buttercream Christmas Cake
products.description: Enchanting holiday showpiece crowned with snow-white buttercream, rich candied berries, festive rosemary wreaths, and gleaming gold greetings.
products.full_description: Spread festive joy and holiday warmth with our signature Christmas showpiece. Handcrafted with spiced vanilla, rich Belgian cocoa, or velvety red velvet sponge, frosted in snowy Swiss meringue buttercream, winter pine cones, and lustrous gold Christmas greetings. A centerpiece for family feasts, carol services, and end-of-year gatherings in Lagos.

products.name: Buttercream Christmas Cake
products.description:
White ribbed buttercream cake with gold pearls and mini Christmas wreath.
Topped with Merry Christmas topper, snowman, gift box and holly bells.
Festive, cute and perfect for your Christmas celebration.
products.full_description: The ultimate celebratory showstopper. Moist chocolate cake cloaked in velvet frosting, featuring a glossy handcrafted chocolate ganache drip cascading over the sides, crowned with Ferrero Rocher chocolates and crisp wafer pearls.

products.name: Fun Mint-to-Lime Ombré Buttercream Cake
products.description: A fun mint-to-lime ombré buttercream cake loaded with colorful sprinkles and bold Roblox character toppers. Featuring the "9" and ROBLOX sign plus a cool avatar face for the ultimate gamer vibe. Perfect for a 9th birthday party for any Roblox fan
products.full_description: A fun mint-to-lime ombré buttercream cake loaded with colorful sprinkles and bold Roblox character toppers. Featuring the "9" and ROBLOX sign plus a cool avatar face for the ultimate gamer vibe. Perfect for a 9th birthday party for any Roblox fan

products.name: 3-Tier luxury wedding
products.description:
A stunning white wedding cake with a square base featuring gold lace detailing, a middle tier with Art Deco gold geometric patterns, and a top tier adorned with cascading burgundy and white roses.
Finished with a gold "Love" topper  regal, romantic and perfect for a grand reception.
products.full_description:
3-Tier luxury wedding cake in white fondant with bold gold lace & geometric detailing.
Adorned with a cascade of burgundy and ivory roses with gold accents.
Elegant, regal & made for a grand Nigerian reception.

products.name: Graduation Cake
products.description:
Pink fondant graduation cake with gold "Congratulations" lettering and black cap with yellow tassel.
Decorated with gold chocolate spheres, pink buttercream swirls and a fondant scroll.
products.full_description:
Pink fondant graduation cake with gold "Congratulations" lettering and black cap with yellow tassel.
Decorated with gold chocolate spheres, pink buttercream swirls and a fondant scroll.

products.name: Baby Shower Cake
products.description:
Elegant white "Mom to be" baby shower cake with butterflies, pearl sprinkles and gold/burgundy spheres. 
Features a beautiful pregnant woman illustration in pink with a turquoise banner.
products.full_description:
Elegant white "Mom to be" baby shower cake with butterflies, pearl sprinkles and gold/burgundy spheres. 
Features a beautiful pregnant woman illustration in pink with a turquoise banner.
